messages:
Aisha (finance): Heads-up — we need to finalize the retro credits schedule for the delayed metering window (Mar 10-12). I want owner commits and rough ETA by EOD today.
Ben (billing-eng): I can own the backfill script + runbook. estimate: 3 business days to run and validate for all affected accounts.
Priya (customer-success): Can we prioritize high-MRR customers first? A few have already pinged support.
Ben (billing-eng): yes, we'll tier by MRR and outage impact. can we get a list from CS? @Priya plz drop the list here or share the sheet.
Priya (customer-success): sharing now: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/Retro+Credit+Targets (shared view).
Connor (eng-ml): quick note — the delayed usage pattern seems tied to the token-ingest worker restart; I've got a short detection rule we can add to prod to catch future spikes.
Aisha (finance): good — add that to the postmortem action list. We need three buckets: immediate credits (manual & prioritized), automated backfill (script), and prevention (alerts + infra fix).
BillingBot: [incident][BILL-3421] Metering ingestion delay detected 2025-03-10 03:12Z. Auto-label: metering/delay
Ben (billing-eng): Action items from my side: 1) backfill script + dry-run (owner: Ben) 2) validation harness and checksum (owner: Ben) 3) deploy automated ingest alert (owner: Connor)
Aisha (finance): ownership recorded. timeline request: Ben - dry-run by Thu COB (2025-03-20), full run Fri morning (2025-03-21). Connor - alert live by Wed (2025-03-19). Priya - provide prioritized customer list by today EOD.
Priya (customer-success): list posted and flagged 7 customers as P0. I'll notify them once credits are applied.
Connor (eng-ml): alert rule: if token-lag > 5m and pending-ingest > 1000 then page + create ticket. I'll post rule snippet in the runbook.
Aisha (finance): For invoicing: some invoices will need reissue/credit memos. Ben, can you make the backfill idempotent and produce a reconciliation CSV for accounting?
Ben (billing-eng): yes — output will be csv: account_id, invoice_id, credit_amount, run_id. I'll attach to BILL-3421 when done.
Priya (customer-success): customer comms template? can we reuse previous incident note?
Aisha (finance): reuse but add explicit credit timeframe and SLA on reissue (3-5 business days). Priya draft due tomorrow.
Ben (billing-eng): Dry-run logs snippet: ```
# dry-run output
processed: 1243 accounts
potential_credits_total_tokens: 9,842,331
skipped: 12 accounts (manual review)
```
Connor (eng-ml): recurring pattern note — ingest restarts every ~6 weeks on that host group. I'll schedule a deeper root-cause follow-up with infra (owner: Connor) and link to infra ticket.
Aisha (finance): OK — summary checklist: - Owners assigned (Ben/Connor/Priya) - Dry-run & validation - Prioritized customer credits - CSV for accounting - Customer comms draft - Infra RCA follow-up. Marking target close: 2025-03-25 for all remediation items.
Ben (billing-eng): I'm starting the dry-run now. will ping here with run_id and logs. :thumbsup:
Priya (customer-success): noted. I'll coordinate comms and confirm once credits applied to the 7 P0s.
Aisha (finance): thanks team. add any blockers here. If anyone needs accel (more hands for validation), call it out.
Ben (billing-eng): run_id=backfill-20250318-01. posting initial report in BILL-3421.
BillingBot: [deploy] backfill job scheduled: backfill-20250318-01 queued on billing-cluster-3
Connor (eng-ml): I'll stand by to flip the alert to prod once Ben confirms dry-run looks good.
Aisha (finance): closing loop — we'll reconvene Fri 11am PT for a short sync and to confirm invoice reissues. Invite coming. :calendar:
Priya (customer-success): thanks, see you Fri.
Ben (billing-eng): thanks — will update status in the ticket and here after validation.
